info.title: JRS International School API
info.description: OpenAPI documentation for the public JRS International School content APIs and enquiry form submissions used by the separately hosted website. Admin dashboard routes use Laravel session authentication and are not part of this API.

title.example: ★ Admissions Open for Academic Year 2027–2028 (Nursery to Grade XII) — Enroll Today!

AdmissionEnquiryRequest.description: Snake-case fields are canonical. The API also accepts academicYear, admissionType, parentMobile, and studentDob. academic_year, branch, and admission_type default when omitted. status is accepted for legacy compatibility but new enquiries are always stored as pending.

status.description: Legacy input only; the API sets new records to pending.

ContactInquiryRequest.description: Snake-case fields are canonical. The API also accepts parentName/name, phoneNumber/phone_number/mobile, gradeOfChild/grade_of_child, emailAddress/email_address, and yourQuery/your_query/query. New enquiries are always stored with status pending.

section.title: Admission Process
section.description: Follow these simple steps to complete the admission process at JRS.

data.title: Meet The Admission Officer
data.description: Visit the school campus and meet our admission officer for guidance.

data.title: Procure The Application Form
data.description: Collect the application form from the school or download it as provided.

data.title: Register With Us
data.description: Submit the completed application form with the required details.

data.title: Appear For The Admission Test
data.description: The student needs to appear for the admission test as per the grade.

data.title: Appear For The Personal Interview
data.description: The student and parents may be called for a personal interview.

data.title: Pay Fee
data.description: Upon selection, complete the fee payment to confirm admission.

section.title: Frequently Asked Questions
section.description: Find answers to commonly asked questions about admissions, academics, and life at JRS.

data.question: What is the admission procedure?
data.answer: The admission procedure begins with obtaining and filling out the application form either online or at the school office, followed by an interaction/competency assessment, document verification, and fee payment.

data.question: Is admission guaranteed?
data.answer: Admission is offered strictly on a first-come, first-served basis, subject to availability of seats and meeting the admission criteria.
